title: Shrek, the friendly ogre.
lines: In a swamp lives a big green ogre.
Shrek has funny ears, like little trumpets.
He takes a bath in the mud.
One day a chatty donkey comes along.
He talks and talks and never stops.
You're so big and so green!
The three little pigs, Pinocchio, the big bad wolf and seven dwarfs.
The wicked Lord Farquaad has chased them out of his land.
Now they're all in Shrek's swamp.
But first you must fetch a princess for me.
She's in a tower, and a dragon guards her.
Shrek and Donkey set off on a journey.
They come to a castle full of lava.
The dragon is big and red.
But the dragon thinks Donkey is very sweet.
Fiona thought a knight would come.
Shrek and Fiona talk and laugh.
Shrek says that ogres are like onions.
They have lots of layers inside.
Fiona learns that Shrek is kind inside.
And Shrek learns that Fiona is funny and tough.
Every evening, when the sun goes down, she changes.
Then she becomes an ogre too.
She's afraid that nobody will like her then.
But Shrek thinks she's just right the way she is.
Fiona doesn't want to marry the wicked Farquaad.
She marries Shrek, in the swamp.
All the fairy-tale characters dance at the party.
And they live happily ever after, in the mud.
